txt: *Beeaautiful*... Believe me, stupid ape, its lack of beauty was *not* the problem.
*Now* you're finally thinking about something other than yourself. Let's see how far that'll get you.
...But it never seems to let *you* go, does it? Time to rise and wipe that shining sweat off as best you can. Gather your bearings. Rock and roll.
...a bitter, caustic sense of loss remains. Even in the darkness, great sorrows slip in the water -- slimy.
...but just *imagine* the moves you could pull to this futuristic beat!
...is much, *much* worse than that.
A fiery streak penetrates your skull, trying to force your eyes open. It's a sound. A clarion call from hell.
After centuries of darkness, the alarm rings -- but what's this? You *actually* feel rested. There's no time to cuddle with your pillow, however, or as much as shiver from the cold. The world awaits.
Ah, yes. And in the olfactory system they call it The Apricot Chewing Gum Scented One. It's unhealthy of them to linger on it so. But -- as they say -- what do you do?
All *stuck* on loop... Whirling, spitting out words and images.

An awareness creeps up on you. A mass lies hidden in your dead angle, soaking in some lurid, acidic sauce. It's bloated and shameful, a ball of meat surrounding you... This is a terrible line of questioning, and it will only lead to more awareness of the meat-thing.
And a little something in there... a sensation. The bow drawn across a string. Something small and crustacean-like.
And rotting. And being disinfected. And smelling of drugs and feeling saliva in his mouth. Drifting in painkillers. Thrashing in his wound sleep.
And the shape of the insect, its cyclical praying motion just... going on and on. That thing. Looking at you. You -- two things standing in front of each other...
And why might *that* be the case? What love alights on such a bloated corpse-to-be?
Beautiful? It's *stuck* on loop... whirling, spitting out words and images.
Because it's always there.
Beep-beep-beep! The alarm is ringing, Harry. The disco circus goes on and on! You barely slept three hours last night.
Behold, there are *millions* of them down there. The first time. The last time. The smoke in her mouth, the potted flowers, the faces: turning, changing.
Coz only love can break your heart...
Did you hear that? He's renouncing politics. He's *strictly business* now.
Don't be stupid Harry, it's not happening. They don't make new *kidneys* and *livers* in hospital. All you've got to do is pray to god it passes -- while you *stare* at the flickering darkness.
Enjoy it while it lasts.
Everything is *so* okay.
For now -- a little while -- you can...
He speaks of the *sickening* longing, the unwell emotion. Even in the darkness he's grasping for it, still trying to hold on to the great sorrows slipping in the water -- slimy.
He's *not* taking it. His body is not taking it. Oh god, no, he's not disintegrating -- he's swelling up instead. Over the hours. Hurting. Moaning in his sleep.
Hear that? He doesn't even flinch. Ice-man doesn't care about killing people. That's *nothing* to him. Black water under the bridge. The thing he's *really* scared of...
Hear that? Ice-man wants to sleep, he doesn't care about killing people. That's *nothing* to him. Black water under the bridge. The thing he's *really* scared of...
Hear that? You were *naive* to think he's afraid of his bloodied hands, soul brother. Oh no, I see inside his amygdala and his hippocampus. The thing he's *really* scared of...
Here in the Paleo-Mammalian Cortex we call it -- *the shadow*.
Here we are again, my broken bird. The waves are coming... carrying you away... but you can't go. No -- you have to stay. Always half-aware of yourself.
Hours turn to days. Soon he will get up again and go through it -- again! Again! Finally, we know what the infernal engine was, outside -- the clarion call...
How's it going out there? Are the tiny apes screaming about money yet?
Infinitesimally small.
It certainly ain't Harry.
It didn't smell *nice*. It smelled like BETRAYAL.
It was *him*. *He* is the infernal engine. He never stops. He only gets worse.
It's *STILL* not over, he's hurting now. Deep inside, the minuscule matter which you are composed of persists. The ride never ends. It just gets harder.

It's easier, this time, drifting off. Your head has found a comfortable indent in the pillow. Your legs and your torso feel like lead weights sinking to the bottom of the sea, until they're suddenly light...
It's not possible anymore. It's *stuck* on loop... Whirling, spitting out words and images.

It's your disgusting *body*. Even through your sleep, you feel a vague discomfort suffusing it. Your belly and your sides are unpleasantly tender. You wish you could curl up into a foetal ball of safety, but you cannot -- because of the PAIN.
Kim? There is no Kim. There is no fight, it's over -- it *was*...
Like a deftly cast fishing net, sleep pulls you out of the world and into its dark shore. The rough mesh chafes, then, tightening around you, it digs into your brain.
Literally all of you.
No. It was *him*. *He* is the infernal engine, can't you see? He never stops. He only gets worse.

Oh yes, party boy. And it's *worse* than the one before! Just think of the shit you saw! Here it comes too, so soon already! A silent alarm goes off in your head, like clockwork, barely let you sleep at all... Time to get those clothes on, Harry!
Oh, baby boy. You're already *in* the other place. There's no nourishment for you tonight. Maybe tomorrow?
Oh, but you are. They're pouring something on you, *in* you. It's...
Reading your awful letters and *recalling* things, aren't you? The endless names of the world... An address book, you are. The map of a city.
Recorded in you. Forever. On ferrotape.
So-something is *wrong*. Sleep shouldn't be this bad. This dry. This un-nourishing. There's something wrong with your thoughts. Some kind of... new type of hangover...

Solving your little crossword puzzles? Doing your tasks, crossing names off your lists? Trying to become some sort of world-detector... It won't make it *okay*. It won't put smoke back in her mouth...
Stinky boy.
The fight? There is no fight. The fight is over -- it was lost. A thousand years ago. You have laid here forever. Keep falling. Deeper... take the door.
The last dream will be total annihilation. Cinders peeling off the fuselage. We won't be there to help you anymore, Harry. We will be dormant. You will be naked and alone.
The stench of liquor rises from your mouth. And with it -- an *un-godly* headache.
There he goes again. He's a real political animal, our Harry. He still doesn't see that it's the world that's changing *him*...
There's this giant ball there. And evil apes. And the evil apes are dukin' it out on the ball. You're one of them. It's basically all just evil apes dukin' it out on a giant ball.
Time to go to work in the shit factory!

Vying for resources? It's just a stupid expression you picked up somewhere. The part of the presentation you want to take home with you is this: you have to beat the other evil apes in the face or you lose.

What do you think you're doing right now? Coming to some greater awareness? Look at all these lights! Blinking in and out of existence -- *thoughts*! You're just *pretending* that you're asleep, even to yourself. While the world goes on without you...
When the pictograms and the hieroglyphs of the world return, they seem silent somehow. The alarm rings quietly too. You're ready.
Yes, it is. And you drowned in that sadness a long time ago.
Yes, they're *pouring* something on you -- something *in* you. And it's...
Yes, you're one disco mother.
Yes, your body is a system, and and it's failing you because you're failing it.
You can't even make out it's a ball, when you're dukin' it out. It's that large.
You do so many times. Until dim light starts peeking into the hood you're under. The rough karakul. More and more each second. Time to face it again -- the world. Anew...
You lost.

You wouldn't like it if I told you what's back there. Why do you think you had to bludgeon yourself into oblivion? Or did you not sense yourself -- marinating? Poured so much over yourself... Got a bit *carried away* did we, chef?
You're not *cooperating* brother-man.
Your eyelids flutter open for a moment. When you close them again, you sense the light of the room around you -- you're back. In two seconds the alarm will ring.
Your name is *Passed Out on the Ground*. Dragged around by one of the other evil apes. They're taking you somewhere...

"I would often go there. To the tiny church there. The smallest church in Saint-Saëns -- though it once was larger.

How the rill may rest there. Down through the mist there. Toward the seven sisters -- toward those pale cliffs there

I would often stay there. In the tiny yard there. I have been so glad here -- looking forward to the past here

But now you are alone. None of this matters at all."
